Happiest regular season game: November 6, 2011 Ravens at Steelers. The Ravens had beat the Steelers on a last minute Flacco TD throw in 2010, but it was against Charlie Batch. They blew-out the Steelers in week 1 against Roethlisberger. But it was this game that felt the best. A last minute TD throw by Flacco after getting the ball back on their own 8 yard line with just over 2 minutes left and trailing by 4. It gave the Ravens a season sweep of the Steelers and for the first time since probably 2000, they felt like a Super Bowl caliber team.

Happiest post-season game: Super Bowl XLVII Ravens against the 49ers (Rocky Mountain Rainbow game against the Broncos is a close second)

Saddest regular season game: November 24, 1991, Cowboys 24, Redskins 21. Going waaaaay back from before the Ravens were even a franchise. I loathed the Cowboys at the time with a passion and rooted for the Redskins. The Redskins losing their undefeated season at 11-0 absolutely devastated me at the time. I don't even remember them winning the Super Bowl that year, just that loss against the Cowboys.

Saddest post-season game: 2011 AFCCG Ravens at Patriots: Freaking Lee Evans and Billy Cundiff.
